$comment: The open-source repos the personas analyse. Every citation and cached run verifies against the pinned commit, never against moving main. Selection criteria: .kiro/steering/demo-patient.md (load with #demo-patient).

primary.why: Two decades of accreted Python packaging cruft. The deepest debt story of the three and instantly recognisable to the audience.
primary.risk: Largest of the three. Analysis time is unmeasured until ingest exists.

fallback.why: A quarter the size of setuptools and far more widely known. Strong staleness narrative: very stable, very low churn.
fallback.risk: Comparatively clean code, so the Debt Collector has less to collect.

ci_fixture.why: Small enough to clone and analyse on every CI run for free. Last touched 2025-06-14, so it also exercises the staleness analyzer with a genuinely stale repo.
ci_fixture.risk: Too small to carry the demo on its own.

decision_rule: setuptools is the demo patient if a full analysis completes in under 60 seconds on the demo host. Otherwise switch to requests and record the measurement below. Judges will not wait.

measured_analysis_seconds.method: ingest_url + signals.run_all on this machine, full clone
measured_analysis_seconds.verdict: setuptools stays primary: 20.4 s total against the 60 s rule, all three analyzers ok, no marker truncation. The one-blame-per-file rule in R2.19a holds; analysis alone is 3.0 s.

obligations: Honour each licence. Quote only what a citation requires and link to the source at the pinned commit.
The humour targets the code and the passage of time, never the maintainers.
Re-verify the LICENSE file at clone time; do not rely on this record alone.
